94:     const creation = (async () => {
95:       await ctx.get('loader')?.await()
96:       // The include settles when every entry reached a terminal state, but a
97:       // service injected late (settings document publish, sibling rows) can
98:       // still be absent at settle time. Poll for the services this session
99:       // needs before touching the agent factory.
100:       const deadline = Date.now() + 30000
101:       while (ctx.get('agentLoop') === undefined || ctx.get('sessionPersistence') === undefined) {
102:         if (Date.now() > deadline) {
103:           throw new Error(
104:             `demo-server: agent factory or persistence never became available `
105:             + `(agentLoop=${ctx.get('agentLoop') !== undefined}, `
106:             + `sessionPersistence=${ctx.get('sessionPersistence') !== undefined})`,
107:           )
108:         }
109:         await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 100))
110:       }
111:       const agents = ctx.get('agents')
112:       const persistence = ctx.get('sessionPersistence')
113:       if (agents === undefined || persistence === undefined) {
114:         throw new Error('demo-server: agents/persistence unavailable at prompt time')
115:       }
116:       const id = SessionId(sessionId)
117:       const agentOptions = {
118:         provider: settings.provider,
119:         model: settings.model,
120:         ...settings.maxTokens === undefined ? {} : { maxTokens: settings.maxTokens },
121:       }
122:       let resumed = false
123:       let eventCount = 0
124:       let handle
125:       const headers = await persistence.list()
126:       const header = headers.find(item => item.id === id)
127:       if (header !== undefined) {
128:         // R2: resume restores the PERSISTED header (meta:{cwd} is never
129:         // passed on resume — DSH has no runtime cwd mutation semantics).
130:         handle = await agents.resume({ resumeSessionId: id, agentOptions })
131:         resumed = true
132:         eventCount = handle.agent.session.seq
133:         // The resumed handle's header is the authority; compare it with the
134:         // Router-resolved effective workspace BEFORE any message is queued.
135:         // On mismatch the loaded handle is discarded (best effort) — the
136:         // persisted session itself stays untouched, cwd still as persisted.
137:         try {
138:           assertSessionCwd(sessionId, handle, effectiveCwd)
139:         } catch (error) {
140:           await handle.dispose?.().catch?.(() => {})
141:           throw error
142:         }
143:       }
144:       if (!resumed) {
145:         // R1: the only creation contract — the effective workspace freezes
146:         // into the new session's header at create time.
147:         handle = await agents.create({ sessionId: id, meta: { cwd: effectiveCwd }, agentOptions })
148:       }
149:       sessionOrigins.set(handle,{disposition:resumed?'resumed':'created',reason:resumed?'persisted_main_resumed':'main_artifact_absent',
150:         provenance:'native_session_resolution',generation_change_reason:null,generation_change_reason_availability:'unknown_no_native_reset_cause'})
151:       handles.set(sessionId, handle)
152:       process.stderr.write(
153:         `[demo-server] session ${sessionId} ${resumed ? 'resumed' : 'created'} (${eventCount} events) cwd=${effectiveCwd}\n`,
154:       )
155:       return handle
